title: mixcore core API v0.5: StateListener.OnState(stateJSON)
description: A snapshot replaces everything the UI holds; a diff lists changes since the previous message. seq grows by one per message; a gap never happens within one Start. Values are the console's, never the UI's. events report holds that ended without the user releasing them; they appear in snapshots and diffs and are never dropped by coalescing (up to 256 between two messages).

demo.description: v0.3 (additive), demo mixer: true in every message (snapshot and diff) of a session to the built-in demo mixer (StartDemo). The UI shows the Demo pill and the banner 'Demo mixer: changes go nowhere' (design 6.3) and never offers it as a real console. Everything else (status, gestures, echo, meters, safety rules) behaves as with a console. Absent means a real console.

status.description: live: input unlocked. stale: connection lost (no packet from the console for 1.5 s, or the console stopped answering), last values shown, Apply returns ERR_STALE. connecting: not yet connected since Start/Resume. stopped: Stop or Pause. status, reason, staleSinceMs, offline (and the v0.1 connection fields below) describe the connection in every message, snapshot or diff; an absent optional field means false or none.

reasonCode.description: Additive (wing): a stable code for why the status is not live, when the core knows one; absent otherwise (reason stays diagnostic text). ERR_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: the console answers, but its protocol is not what this core understands (wing: its schema lacks or contradicts the nodes the core needs, or it sends bytes the protocol does not define). The core keeps retrying with a backoff of 1, 2, 4 ... up to 30 s, and goes live by itself when the console's protocol matches. Suggested UI text: 'This mixer's firmware speaks a protocol Mixhand does not understand yet'.

reason.description: Diagnostic text for logs, never shown to users as is.

staleSinceMs.description: v0.1. Present only while status is stale: when the connection was lost, as Unix time in milliseconds (wall clock of this device). The UI counts up from it ('Reconnecting 0:07'). It does not move while reconnect attempts fail; it disappears when the status leaves stale.

limited.description: v0.1. True while the console accepts this engine but does not send it updates because its remote client slots are full (design SR-17, CR-10; x32: four push clients; xair: eight). Values may be stale and are shown as such; Apply returns ERR_STALE and every hold is cancelled (holdCancelled, reason limited) although status stays live. It clears by itself as soon as an update arrives; a Pause and Resume retries. There is no polling fallback (CR-15 is unverified). Absent means false.

limitedReason.description: v0.1. Present with limited: the evidence. noEchoOfOwnWrites: three writes that changed an input or main fader or mute got no confirmation while the console answered. rereadFoundUnpushedChanges: two background re-reads in a row found an input or main fader or mute that changed without an update. v0.4: bus, send, colour, link, group, name and Gain values never count (x32.md "Client limit detection").

offline.description: v0.1. True once status has been stale for 30 s (design 8.1 'Offline', a stronger label only: the core keeps retrying at the same pace). Absent means false.

showMode.description: v0.3, every message: show mode is on (SR-27). Absent means off.

unlockedHeadamps.description: v0.3, every message while show mode is on: headamps whose Gain raise is unlocked ('Gain unlocked for ...'). An unlock ends on relock, 20 s without a command on it, stale, pause or stop (event gainUnlockEnded).

muteGroupMembership.description: Additive (wing), snapshot only: false when the console does not report which mute groups a strip belongs to (wing, docs/protocols/wing.md item 11). Strips then have no muteGroups field, and an unmuted strip's effectiveMute.muted is null while any mute group is engaged. Absent means true.

showModeLocked.description: v0.5, every message: show mode is locked on by the owner's PIN (README rule 16): setShowMode false and unlock are ERR_ROLE until unlockShowMode. Absent means not locked. The PIN record never appears in a state message.

clientId.description: The client whose own layer this is; absent: the default layer (from the config) of every client that has not set its own.

favourites.description: v0.5: the favourites layers (README rule 17), per client (review sec L4): the default first, then each client's own, by clientId. In every snapshot (when any layer has strips) and in the first message after setFavourites. A hub sends each device only its own layer (hub requirements).

undo.description: v0.5 (redesign CC-6, README rule 14), every message while a client has undo history: per clientId its newest entry, the one undo would take, with what undoing it would ask. Absent: no client has anything to undo.

strips.description: snapshot only: inputs in order, then main. v0.4: inputs carry sends.

kind.description: input and main only; headamps are in headamps (v0.3).

muteGroups.description: v0.1: mute groups this strip belongs to. v0.2: absent on a strip that has no mute-group membership on its console (xair: main).

dcas.description: v0.1: DCA groups this strip belongs to (inputs only on x32 and xair).

headamp.description: v0.3, inputs on x32 only (/-ha/NN/index, X32-F74): the headamp feeding this channel, null when its source has none (card, USB, internal: the channel has no Gain). Absent when the family does not model it (xair) or the console did not answer /-ha. Several channels may use one headamp: one Gain write changes all of them. Read-only.

colour.description: v0.4: the strip colour (inputs and main, X32-F89, xair section 3.2). Absent when the console did not answer colours.

sends.description: v0.4, inputs only: this channel's send to every bus of the snapshot's buses list, in bus order. Changes arrive in diffs as param {strip: {kind: input, index}, field: sendLevel | sendOn | sendPan | sendTap, bus}.

absentInputs.description: v0.2, snapshot only, xair: input strips the family documents (16, XA-F71) that this mixer did not answer when the engine first connected (a small model, or a link too lossy to probe, XA-F72). They stay absent until Stop and Start; strips that answered once are never dropped on a reconnect. Absent when every documented input answered. UI: 'Inputs 13-16 not found on this mixer'.

headamps.description: v0.3, snapshot only: every headamp the core reads, with its own Gain law (CR-23). xair: mic 1..16 (fewer on XR16/XR12, XA-F73), aux 17 on the 18-channel models; XR16/XR12 line inputs are absent (numbering unverified, XA-F110). x32: local 1..32 (fewer on a model with fewer local inputs) and the AES50 headamps some channel's /-ha index points at; a patch change that brings in another one is followed by a snapshot. Changes arrive in diffs as param {strip: {kind: headamp, index}, field: gain or phantom}.

minDB.description: Range and console step of this headamp's law: mic (xair mic, x32 all) -12..+60 dB, 0.5 dB (X32-F71, XA-F111); line (xair aux) -12..+20 dB, 0.5 dB (XA-F112). UI step = max(1 dB, stepDB).

writeMaxDB.description: The highest value a write may set: one step below maxDB, because the wire maximum 1.0 is not confirmed safe to write (xair.md XA-F116 item 22, x32.md X32-F72 item 17). A set above it is ERR_INVALID_VALUE; a Gain gesture's cap stops at it. +59.5 dB mic, +19.5 dB line. If hardware (x32.md item 17, xair.md item 22) shows a family does not echo Gain writes, that family's Gain becomes read-only (writable false).

writable.description: false: shown, never written (a set is ERR_UNSUPPORTED). x32 AES50 headamps (ownership and the effect of a write unknown, X32-F76) and xair aux (line law unconfirmed, XA-F112) are read-only. The core never writes with a law it has not confirmed.

bank.description: Where the console says this input is, for the UI label: local (x32 local XLR, xair mic), AES50 A or B (x32 stage boxes; the B numbering is unverified, X32-F70 item 16), aux (xair stereo aux).

number.description: The console's own number within the bank: x32 /headamp/036 is AES50 A 05; xair /headamp/03 is local 3.

phantom.description: 48 V on. Present only where the core reads it: x32 local and xair mic headamps (X32-F73, XA-F113). Read-only for now: a future show-mode gate.

changes.description: diff only; present (possibly empty) in every diff. v0.1: when a mute, a group state or a membership changes, the core also lists every strip whose effectiveMute changed, as field effectiveMute with the origin of the change that caused it.

oneOf.description: The desk, a scene recall or another client changed a parameter this client was holding. The console's value is already in state (in changes, or in the snapshot). The gesture has ended: Apply for this param from this client returns ERR_GESTURE_ENDED until a new holdBegin (or holdEnd). Suggested UI text: 'Changed at the mixer: -10.0 dB'.

The hold was cancelled because the console went stale, the engine was stopped/paused or (v0.1) the console stopped sending updates (limited). No write resumes when the status returns to live: the UI must send a new holdBegin.

reason.description: limited is v0.1. role (v0.4): the client's role changed (Go API SetClientRole, the hub) and no longer allows this parameter.

oneOf.description: v0.1 (design SR-15, CR-03). The console has no scene-recall message (x32: X32-F60; xair: XA section 7), so the core infers it: a burst of at least 8 different parameters pushed within 250 ms, and pushes of the console's scene markers if it sends them (x32: /-undo/time, /-show/prepos/current; xair, v0.2: /-snap/index, a hint only; whether either console sends them is unverified). Every held fader has ended (externalChangeOnHeld events in the same message) and the core re-reads the console in the background. Suggested UI text: 'Scene recalled at the mixer' (high or medium), or nothing beyond the per-fader messages (low). The core never loads, saves or deletes a scene or snapshot itself: there is no such command in this contract (xair slot 64 may hold another app's data, XA-F63). v0.5 (CC-10): sceneNumber and sceneName name the recalled scene when the core knows them; the undo history is cut at this event (undo asks beforeSceneRecall). UI text: 'Scene "Song 4" recalled at the mixer', 'Scene 12 recalled at the mixer', else 'Scene recalled at the mixer'.

confidence.description: high: a burst and the console's recall marker (x32: the undo checkpoint /-undo/time); medium: that marker alone; low: a burst alone (another app changing many parameters at once looks the same). Hints never raise the event and never raise the confidence: the x32 highlighted scene and the xair snapshot index (/-snap/index is 'recently loaded/saved', XA-F60, so a save moves it too). On xair every recall is low until hardware shows more (xair.md test item 13).

signals.description: snapshotIndex is v0.2 (xair: /-snap/index was pushed within 1 s of the burst; a hint, like highlightedScene).

highlightedScene.description: Present when the console pushed /-show/prepos/current: the scene (or cue/snippet, per the console's show-control setting) HIGHLIGHTED on its scenes page, not necessarily the one loaded (X32-F61). Show it as a hint only.

loadedScene.description: v0.2, xair only. Present when the console pushed /-snap/index within 1 s of the burst that raised this event: the snapshot it reports as recently loaded or saved (XA-F60, 1..64). A lone /-snap/index push (for example after a save in another app) raises no event. Show it as a hint: 'Snapshot 12 at the mixer'.

sceneNumber.description: v0.5: the scene (snapshot) the console reported as loaded with this recall: xair /-snap/index within 1 s of the burst (the same value as loadedScene). Absent when unknown; x32 never sets it (its highlighted scene is not the loaded one, X32-F61).

sceneName.description: v0.5: the name of that scene when the core knows it (user content). Absent when unknown or empty.

oneOf.description: v0.3: a Gain unlock in show mode ended (SR-27); raising Gain on that headamp is locked again. An undo of an entry made during the unlock stays allowed for 10 s.

reason.description: showModeLocked (v0.5): the owner locked show mode with a PIN; every unlock and its undo grace end (README rule 16).

oneOf.description: v0.5 (CC-11, README rule 15): something this client did not do changed the bus it watches (the desk, a scene recall, another client). At once for the first change, then at most once per 2 s while changes continue. UI text: 'Mon 2 changed at the mixer', at most once per 10 s.

count.description: Changes since the previous event of this watch.

events.description: Events report holds that ended without the user releasing them and (v0.1) scene recalls detected at the console. They appear in snapshots and diffs and are never dropped by coalescing (up to 256 between two messages).

muteGroups.description: v0.1, snapshot only: every mute group of the console; mute true = engaged. Changes arrive in diffs as param {strip: {kind: muteGroup, index}, field: mute}. Absent when the console has none (or did not answer for them).

name.description: v0.4: present when the console has DCA masters (x32 X32-F88, xair section 3.2).

faderDB.description: v0.4: the DCA fader, writable (param {strip: {kind: dca, index}, field: fader}); present with DCA masters.

dcas.description: v0.1, snapshot only: every DCA group; mute true = DCA muted. v0.4: name, colour and faderDB where the console has DCA masters.

buses.description: v0.4, snapshot only: every bus the console answered for, in index order (x32: mix buses 1..16; xair: buses 1..6 (kind mix) and the FX send masters 1..4 as buses 7..10 (kind fx)). A bus that did not answer at the engine's first connect is absent with every send to it (small xair models, XA-F72). Changes arrive in diffs as param {strip: {kind: bus, index}, field}.

kind.description: mix: a mix (aux) bus, the usual monitor mix. fx: an FX send master (xair FX 1..4 = buses 7..10). Name it 'FX 1' .. 'FX 4' when its name is empty.

faderDB.description: The bus master ('My level' in the monitor view).

linked.description: Present on the odd bus of each pair the console can link (x32 1-2 .. 15-16, X32-F81; xair 1-2, 3-4, 5-6): true = the pair is one stereo bus, the odd bus is left, the even bus right. Show the pair as one mix ('Mon 1 (stereo)'). Read-only. Whether the console copies a write on one side to the other is unverified (x32.md item 25): the core writes exactly the parameter it is given.

sendPan.description: Present (true) when inputs have a send pan into this bus, in the scope sendFields.pan gives. The family's protocol doc decides, not the console's answer: x32 every bus, the pan living on the odd send of each pair (X32-F84); xair buses 1..6, never the FX sends 7..10 (xair.md 3.3, item 10). Absent: no pan bar for sends into this bus.

meterIndex.description: v0.5 (CC-13): the level of this bus's meter in the meter frame (meter-frame.md). Absent: the frame has no meter for this bus.

matrices.description: v0.4, snapshot only, x32: matrices 1..6 (X32-F87), read-only (a set is ERR_UNSUPPORTED). Absent on xair and when the console did not answer them.

sendFields.description: v0.4, snapshot only, present when inputs carry sends: which send fields this console has. level is always there. on: the console has a send on/off (x32 yes, xair no: show no SEND ON/OFF switch and never send sendOn). pan and tap: 'send' = every send has its own; 'pair' = only the odd bus of each pair has it and it belongs to the pair (x32, X32-F84/F85: the tap shown under an even bus's send is the one of the odd bus below it, and a sendPan set must name the odd bus); absent = the console has none or did not answer. A bus without sendPan in its buses entry has no send pan whatever sendFields.pan says.

sendTaps.description: v0.4, snapshot only, with sendFields.tap: the console's own word for each sendTap token, in signal-flow order (x32: IN/LC, <-EQ, EQ->, PRE, POST, GRP; xair: IN, PREEQ, POSTEQ, PRE, POST, GRP). Show the label, untranslated (CR-16).

levelDB.description: The send level (x32 X32-F82/F83, xair section 3.3: the fader law in 161 steps).

on.description: true = the send is on. Absent when the console has no send on/off (sendFields.on false: xair).

pan.description: Present where sendFields.pan says (x32: odd buses only).

tap.description: Present where sendFields.tap says (x32: odd buses only). Read-only in v0.4.

param.description: The target: the parameter the entry changed; the UI names it from the snapshot ('Vox1', 'Gain 3 Gtr', 'Mon 2: Gtr').

kind.description: level: fader, gain, sendLevel (dB); switch: mute, sendOn (boolean); pan: sendPan.

from.description: The value before the change: what undo writes.

delta.description: to - from, in dB (level) or pan units; absent for a switch or when either end is -inf.

direction.description: The way the change went: up (raise), down (lowering), none (switches, pans). The Undo label's arrow.

asks.description: What undoing it would ask, as of this message (README rule 14); empty: one tap undoes it. An undo without confirmed while any applies is ERR_NEEDS_CONFIRM.

scene.description: With beforeSceneRecall: the recall that cut the history after this entry ('This change was before scene "Song 4" was recalled'); number and name when known.
